description.value:
A wave of psychic distortion floods the minds of every creature within a 30-foot radius of you, conjuring delusions and provoking wild, uncontrolled behavior. Each affected creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall under the power's influence; it has no effect on constructs or droids.

An affected creature cannot take reactions, and at the start of each of its turns it rolls a d8 to determine its behavior: on a 1, it flees its full movement in a random direction and takes no action; on a 2-6, it neither moves nor acts; on a 7-8, it lashes out with a melee attack at a random creature within its reach, or does nothing if none is in reach.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature may attempt another Wisdom save to shake off the effect early.

Cast with a slot of 6th level or higher, the radius of the affected area expands by 5 feet per slot level beyond 5th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 5
